title.narrative: UNICEF strategically engaged with the Government and partners to advance integrated, inclusive and shock-responsive social protection reforms, including approval of the Laws on Social Assistance and on State Benefits, development of social protection information management systems, leveraging of resources for national cash schemes and capacity strengthening of social workers to mitigate effects of poverty, deprivation and shocks on families and children. As part of the response to the 2023 refugee influx, UNICEF reached 11,335 refugee households (estimated 47% of all refugee households) with multipurpose vouchers for clothing and pharmacy cards.
